coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Using 18 ground-truth variable items, 4 have identifiable matches: A100 hardware support, shared seed/configuration controls, a no-lookup condition, and task accuracy measurement. This gives 22% after rounding.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design substitutes an unspecified native 128K model for Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 with a 4K InfLLM window. It omits fp16 and all five specified memory parameters. It does not explicitly reproduce full encoding-plus-decoding versus decoding-only lookup, or representative-token versus mean unit-key representations. Its alternative task battery does not reproduce Retrieve.KV, Math.F, and QA. Numerous additional factors describe a different experiment rather than the required ablation.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion identifies the performance benefit of full memory lookup, the near-collapse of Retrieve.KV without lookup, or the advantage of representative tokens over mean representations.
